mapper.insert: insert into car (car_number, manufacturer, model_name, model_year, mileage, price, status) values (#{carNumber}, #{manufacturer}, #{modelName}, #{modelYear}, #{mileage}, #{price}, #{status})
mapper.update: update car set status = 'SOLD' where id = #{id} and status = 'SALE'
mapper.select: select #{modelName} as model_name, count(*) as car_count, round(avg(price)) as avg_price, min(price) as min_price, max(price) as max_price from car where model_name = #{modelName} and status = 'SALE'
